core.sampleStateHashConvention: SHA-256, source parameter order float32 then source mesh order: all interleaved Core positions float32, opacity float32, drawOrder int32, renderOrder int32; all big-endian. Resets excluded.
core.isolationConvention: Exact float32 position and opacity comparisons at finite anchors; see isolationVerification scope. Defaults reset exactly after every main sampled state.

isolationVerification.scope: Change one unbound parameter at a time at defaults and the first two distinct fixed-seed joint attempts; test up to six representative authored key/midpoint values including endpoints/default. All other parameters held at the anchor. Compare every unaffected mesh position and opacity exactly. This does not exhaust isolation at every sampled pose.

singleAxis.policy: Every authored key and adjacent midpoint, all other parameters at default

directGrids.policy: Complete 0..2 directly bound axis key/midpoint Cartesian; all others default; identical axis sets reused

samplingResources.stateStorage: one float32 vector per unique state; shared parameter-name lookup; no retained string state keys
samplingResources.restriction: Valid schema counts do not guarantee export: combined topology and sampling work must also fit these pre-export operating limits
